games.brief: Tier A: PFF point-spread ratings SEA 4.815 vs NE 2.893 with 3.69 HFA give spread_pff SEA -5.607 (PFF QB ratings Maye 5.5, Darnold 3.5, both inside the PSR), while nfelo has SEA -4.0 (home win probability 0.636) with 3.685 HFA and per-QB adjustments of NE +0.12 / SEA -0.09 already baked; the nfelo/PFF Tier-A blend sits at SEA -4.74. The TPT panel is a two-computer light sleeve -- spreads Donchess/DRatings SEA -2.3 and FF-Winners SEA -4.0, panel value -2.64 -- 2.1 points lighter on SEA than Tier A, with Donchess the outlier on this game (2.4 from Tier A; FF-Winners matches nfelo exactly); Pi-Rate and Lou St. John are blank for spreads and RP Excel, Laffaye RWP and Dokter Entropy blank for totals in TPT's own file, and no single-computer clamp was triggered (system_clamps empty). Blended core: spread SEA -4.423 (weights nfelo .46 / PFF .39 / TPT .15) and total 46.36 from nfelo 48.51 (0.5) and the TPT total panel 44.21 (0.5; DONC 44.26, FFW 44.0 -- unanimous 4.3 under nfelo, PFF game total unavailable), with the DVOA diagnostic at 47.04. No section-5 context adjustments were applied: both QBs are confirmed ACT/A01 starters with no post-2026-08-31 news, the only premium-position item (NE EDGE Harold Landry III, QUESTIONABLE, unverified roster code A02, WLB3 on the 8/31 depth chart) is weak evidence and is flagged rather than priced, no NE OT injury exists to trigger the SEA pass-rush (PFF DL rank 5) mismatch category, and no verified forecast exists for outdoor Lumen Field. The team-total split is not 50/50 because the identity carries the 4.4-point spread into it (about SEA 25.4 / NE 21.0 on the core), plus one section-6 pace-possession reallocation of +0.5 SEA / -0.5 NE on the league's most run-heavy, slow offense (52.9% pass rate 32nd, 58.6 plays/g 22nd) in front of the No. 1 EPA/play defense (-0.111) hosting a pass-lean NE offense (61.2%, 14th), game total unchanged. Uncertainty: spread_sd 1.35 across 4 sources; total_sd 2.53 across 3 sources with the light panel carrying half the total weight -- total confidence LOW.

games.brief: Tier A: PFF point-spread ratings LA 6.44 vs SF 2.55 (QB components Stafford 5.5 / Purdy 3.5), less the neutral-site HFA term of -0.18, give spread_pff -3.71; nfelo has LA -2.0 with its neutral-site HFA of -0.181 and per-QB adjustments of LA -0.15 / SF +0.07 already inside it (both QBs ACT/A01 and QB1 on the 8/31 chart, confirmed), so the two Tier-A engines sit 1.7 points apart and blend to roughly -2.78. The TPT panel is light: DONC -4.3 / FF-Winners +2.4 (SF favored) on the spread and DONC 47.78 / FF-Winners 42.5 on the total, with Pi-Rate, Lou St. John, RP Excel, Laffaye and Dokter Entropy blank in TPT's file and no single-computer clamp triggered; the shrunk panel lands at -2.96 and 46.72, i.e. 0.18 points more LA than the Tier-A blend on the spread and 0.89 under nfelo's 47.61 on the total, with FF-Winners the outlier on both (6.7 points from DONC on the spread, 5.3 under DONC on the total), which is what pushes spread_sd to 3.03 across four sources. Cores after weighting: spread LA -2.81 (nfelo .46 / PFF .39 / TPT .15), total 47.17 (nfelo .50 / TPT .50; PFF publishes no total, DVOA 46.93 is diagnostic only). No §5 adjustment is applied: no post-8/31 QB news, no injured-OT/elite-rush pairing (LA's No. 1 PFF pass rush faces a healthy SF OL ranked ~12, and SF's No. 20 rush is not elite against LA's unverified RT change from Havenstein to McClendon Jr.), both teams on 7 days with a symmetric trans-Pacific trip already priced as neutral-site HFA in nfelo and PFF, and no verified forecast or confirmed roof state at the Melbourne Cricket Ground, so weather is flagged rather than priced. Pearsall (IR, WR rank 14 behind Evans/Samuel), Mykel Williams (A02 decode unverified, SLB4), Dimukeje (IR, rotational) and McPhearson (IR, depth CB) are all below the premium-starter bar and zeroed. The team-total split is not 50/50 because the identity already assigns the 2.81-point spread to LA (LA ~25.0 / SF ~22.2 on the 47.17 core) and a +1.0 LA / -1.0 SF explosive-play reallocation is added on top: LA's No. 1 PFF 2025 offense grade (93.6, off EPA/play 0.149, Stafford PFF QB5) meets SF's No. 24 PFF coverage rank, 52.8 defense grade and +0.066 def EPA/play, game total unchanged.

Tier A: PFF's pasted point-spread ratings put CHI at +1.395 and CAR at -2.855 (QB components 4.0 and 1.5), which with 2.41 HFA gives spread_pff 1.837 (CHI -1.8); nfelo has CHI -2.5 with HFA 2.413 and per-QB adjustments of +0.20 (Williams) and +0.12 (Young) already baked in, both QB1s confirmed ACT/A01 on the 8/31 depth chart, and nfelo's 45.805 is the only Tier-A total because PFF publishes none. The TPT panel is two systems only: DONC 2.7 / FFW 2.0 on the spread (panel 2.56, weighted median shrunk 40% toward the unweighted median, +0.36 above the nfelo+PFF blend of 2.196) and DONC 46.99 / FFW 43.9 on the total (panel 46.372, +0.57 above nfelo), with FF-Winners the outlier on the total at 3.09 below DONC and 1.9 below nfelo; Pi-Rate and Lou St. John are blank on spreads and RP Excel, Laffaye RWP and Dokter Entropy blank on totals in TPT's file, and no single-computer clamp was triggered. Blended cores are spread 2.25 (nfelo .46 / PFF .39 / TPT .15) and total 46.089 (nfelo .50 / TPT .50). One adjustment applies, carried unchanged from the audited baseline: ol_pass_rush_mismatch for both CAR starting tackles (Ekwonu A02/QUESTIONABLE demoted to LT4, Moton A06/QUESTIONABLE demoted to RT3, rookie Monroe Freeling listed LT1 and RT1 on 8/31, and PFF's note that CAR 'would have ranked inside the top 12 with their starting tackles'), taken at +0.75 on the spread toward CHI and -1.5 off CAR's team total, both held below ceiling because the statuses are QUESTIONABLE, the roster codes are undecoded and CHI's PFF pass-rush rank was not recovered; the result is CHI -3.0 and a 44.6 total. No qb_change, weather, rest or travel adjustment is supported: no post-8/31 QB news exists, the game is outdoors on grass with no verified forecast, and both teams are on 7 days rest. The team-total split is not 50/50 because the identity already assigns CHI about 3.0 points more than CAR, the protection downgrade is charged wholly to CAR, and a pace-possession modifier (CHI 64.5 plays/g, 2nd, vs CAR 58.6, 23rd) moves a further 0.5 from CAR to CHI with the game total unchanged.
games.brief_problems: All numbers reconcile to the bundle (PSR 1.395/-2.855, QB 4.0/1.5, spread_pff 1.837, nfelo 2.5 with HFA 2.413 and QB adj +0.20/+0.12, total_nfelo 45.805, DONC/FFW 2.7/2.0 and 46.99/43.9, panel 2.56/46.372, blends 2.196 and +0.36/+0.57, FFW 3.09 below DONC and 1.9 below nfelo, cores 2.25/46.089 with weights .46/.39/.15 and .50/.50, blank systems PIR/STJ and RPXL/RWP/DOK, no clamps, adjusted 3.0/44.6, pace 64.5 (2nd)/58.6 (23rd), rank_model_diag gap 1.23, market 2.5 / 45.5 open / 47.5 current). Two wording nits only, neither a factual error: (1) 'with 2.41 HFA gives spread_pff 1.837' — 4.2498 − 2.41 = 1.840; the bundle's 1.837 implies HFA 2.413 (pff_meta rounds to 2.41), so the brief is consistent with the bundle but the arithmetic as stated rounds 0.003 off. (2) 'the protection downgrade is charged wholly to CAR' states the category's intent; the downstream T/2 ± S/2 identity actually distributes the +0.75/-1.5 pair as about -1.125 CAR / -0.375 CHI relative to the unadjusted split. Also, 'DONC 2.7 / FFW 2.0 bracket Tier A' is loose — the TPT range 2.0–2.7 overlaps but does not strictly bracket the Tier A range 1.837–2.5.

Team totals come from the identity alone (CIN 25.77 / TB 22.83): the spread skews the split toward CIN, and no §6 reallocation qualifies — CIN's 2025 defense (0.124 def EPA/play, 29th, pbp2025; 31st in passing success rate allowed per pff.com) faces a league-average TB offense (0.002 off EPA/play, PFF PSR -0.914), while TB's average defense (PFF coverage rank 15, 0.013 def EPA/play) is not a weak explosive-play unit against Burrow/Chase.

games.brief: Tier A: PFF point-spread ratings BUF 4.611 vs HOU 3.146 (QB component Allen 7.0 vs Stroud 3.5; PFF QB ranks 1 and 17), less 1.14 HFA, give spread_pff +0.32 (BUF -0.3); nfelo prints +1.5 (BUF -1.5, home WP 0.447) with 1.141 HFA and QB adjustments Allen +0.28 / Stroud -0.13 already inside it, both starters confirmed HIGH, so Tier A blends to +0.96 on a 3rd-ranked 2025 offense (0.14 EPA/play, 83.3 PFF grade) against a 2025 1st-2nd EPA/play defense (sources split) (PFF DL No. 2, secondary No. 2). TPT panel is a two-computer sleeve (Pi-Rate and Lou St. John blank on spreads, RP Excel, Laffaye RWP and Dokter Entropy blank on totals in TPT's own file; no single-computer clamp triggered): spreads DONC +1.7 / FF-Winners -0.2 sleeve to +1.32, 0.36 above the Tier-A blend, with FF-Winners the outlier at opposite sign to nfelo, PFF and DONC; totals DONC 45.23 / FFW 47.0 sleeve to 45.58, 2.14 below nfelo's 47.72 (PFF carries no total), DONC the low system. No verified forecast exists; NRG's retractable roof is expected closed per an unsourced operational norm, so no weather number is taken.
games.brief_problems: 1) Team-total sentence misstates the identity: 'the identity T/2 ± S/2, which already hands BUF about 0.5 more than HOU on the +1.0 spread'. On S=+1.014 and T=46.153 the identity gives BUF 23.58 / HOU 22.57 — BUF about 1.0 above HOU (0.5 each way from the 23.08 midpoint), not 0.5 more than HOU. The brief's own end figure ('roughly 1.5 above HOU' after the -0.25/+0.25 pair) is correct (23.83 / 22.32, gap 1.51) and only reconciles if the identity gap is 1.0, so the sentence is internally inconsistent as written. Fix: 'which already puts BUF about 1.0 above HOU (0.5 each way from the midpoint) on the +1.0 spread'. The tt_split_note phrases it correctly; the brief does not. 2) Minor: '2025 No. 1 EPA/play defense' follows pff_units.home.note; quality_2025.home says 'Defense 2nd-best EPA/play in 2025' with 'def 1st-2nd both sources'. Say '1st-2nd EPA/play defense (sources split)' to match the bundle's own hedge. 3) Precision: 'an absence the bundle shows no engine or computer pricing' — the bundle is silent on DONC/FFW roster inputs, which is absence of evidence, not evidence of absence; the flag list states this correctly ('unresolved for the TPT computers'), the brief should too. All other numbers verified against the bundle: PSR 4.611/3.146, QB 7.0/3.5, HFA 1.14, spread_pff +0.325, nfelo +1.5 / WP 0.447 / HFA 1.141 / QB adj +0.28 & -0.13, Tier-A blend +0.961, panel +1.32 (0.36 above Tier A) and 45.585 (2.14 below nfelo), DONC 1.7/45.23, FFW -0.2/47.0, cores +1.015/46.653, tilt +0.05, SD 0.917/1.281 over n 4/3, DVOA 47.048, blank systems PIR/STJ (spreads) and RPXL/RWP/DOK (totals), system_clamps empty, PFF QB ranks 1/17, 2025 off EPA 0.14 / grade 83.3, 46.15 adjusted total.

games.brief: Tier A: PFF point-spread ratings BAL +3.606 / IND -1.249 (QB components 7.0 Jackson vs 2.0 Jones) with 2.4 HFA give spread_pff +2.458 (BAL favored by 2.46); nfelo has +1.5 (BAL -1.5, home WP 0.444) with HFA 2.397 and QB adjustments BAL +0.40 / IND +0.03 already inside, so the two Tier-A engines sit within 1.0 of each other and the Tier-A-only blend is +1.94. TPT panel (DONC/FFW only; Pi-Rate and Lou St. John blank on spreads, RP Excel, Laffaye RWP and Dokter Entropy blank on totals in TPT's file; system_clamps empty): spreads DONC +4.5 / FFW -3.6 shrink to a panel value of +2.88, +0.94 above the Tier-A blend, with FF-Winners the outlier - the only source that favors IND, 8.1 points from Donchess and 5.5 from Tier A. Totals: DONC 51.41 / FFW 48.80 give a panel value of 50.89 against nfelo's 46.56 (PFF publishes no total; DVOA diagnostic 46.31), a +4.33 gap that lifts total_core to 48.73 because the PFF-null renormalization hands TPT a 0.5 weight (total_sd 2.43). Blended cores: spread +2.081 (BAL -2.08), total 48.726; spread_sd 3.445 across 4 sources is driven almost entirely by FFW (Tier-A-only SD was 0.68). No section-5 context adjustments and no section-6 reallocations are applied: Lamar Jackson is confirmed, Daniel Jones is QB1 on the 2026-08-31 depth chart with no post-data-date news and is priced by both engines, the only listed absences (OT Kendall Lamm retired, OL Danny Pinter IR, CB Cameron Mitchell IR) are depth pieces behind ACT/A01 starters, and neither Hendrickson-vs-IND-OL nor Latu-vs-BAL-OT meets the injured/weak-OT trigger. Team totals follow the identity split only (T/2 +/- S/2 gives BAL 25.40, IND 23.32); the skew is the 2.08-point spread, not a modifier - no 2026 explosive-play or red-zone metric exists in the bundle and pace is bottom-half on both sides (BAL 56.2 plays/g, 29th; IND 59.5, 20th). Retractable roof, no forecast: no weather number.

Tier A: PFF point-spread ratings JAX +1.658 / CLE -5.761 with HFA 1.78 give spread_pff -9.20, PFF QB ratings JAX 4.5 (Lawrence, confirmed) vs CLE 0.5 (Watson, QB1 on the 2026-08-31 depth chart but unconfirmed after missing all of 2025), and nfelo sits at -7.5 with HFA 1.777 and per-QB adjustments +0.15 JAX / -0.35 CLE already baked and a 0.741 home win probability, so the two Tier-A systems disagree by 1.7 and blend to about -8.28. The TPT panel is light - only Donchess/DRatings and FF-Winners are populated, with Pi-Rate, Lou St. John, RP Excel, Laffaye RWP and Dokter Entropy blank in TPT's own file and no single-computer clamp recorded - and its spread value of -10.14 sits 1.86 further toward JAX than the Tier-A blend; DONC is at -11.8 and FF-Winners at -3.5, an 8.3-point split in which FF-Winners is the outlier (4.8 short of Tier A, 6.6 from the panel value), and at 0.15 weight the panel moves the core only 0.28, to -8.557. On the total PFF has no number, so Tier A is nfelo alone at 45.95; DONC 41.71 and FFW 42.40 agree with each other and sit 4.1 under nfelo (panel 41.85), the 50/50 total core lands at 43.90, and the DVOA diagnostic (45.30) sides with nfelo. Adjustments: the audited baseline is kept unchanged - ol_pass_rush_mismatch at -0.5 on the spread toward JAX and -1.0 on the CLE team total, both at the range minimum because PFF calls the rebuilt CLE line 'still bottom-five' with rookie LT Spencer Fano debuting against healthy Hines-Allen/Walker behind a top-5 EPA/play defense (-0.080), but no PFF pass-rush grade was recovered to justify more; no qb_change (Watson's status is unconfirmed, not new news, and both nfelo and PFF already price him), no weather (no forecast for outdoor EverBank), no rest/travel (7 days each, ET-to-ET, 1:00 ET). That yields spread -9.06 and total 42.90 before the identity split. The team-total split is not 50/50 because the identity puts half the 9.06-point spread on each side of the 42.90 total - JAX ≈ 26.0, CLE ≈ 16.9 - with the -1.0 mismatch hit netting -0.75 onto CLE; no §6 reallocation was earned (pace gap 60.5 vs 63.1 plays/g is modest, and the bundle carries no explosive-play or red-zone data).

games.brief: Tier A: PFF Point Spread Ratings put PIT at -0.50 and ATL at -2.78 (QB component PIT 2.5 Rodgers / ATL 1.5 Tagovailoa), which with 2.4 HFA yields spread_pff -4.67; nfelo sits at -3.00 with 2.40 HFA and per-QB adjustments of +0.56 (Rodgers) and +0.18 (Tagovailoa) already inside it and a .604 PIT win probability, so the nfelo/PFF Tier-A blend is -3.77.
